findings.logic: DOC_EXTS contains .md/.rst/.adoc but not .docx; the root-external file walker records excluded rows only for a short extension set that also omits .docx.
findings.effect: The five project/reference DOCX files are silently absent from the manifest. One additional font-probe DOCX exists under tmp and should remain excluded as a generated probe.
findings.recommended_disposition: Include the two final DOCX and V1.46 reference/update document requested by root; explicitly disposition Guide v11 and the V1.44 plan.

findings.logic: The root-external os.walk prunes tmp/backup_coordinator as a whole.
findings.effect: Authored helper code and all plans/receipts/review evidence in that subtree are outside the non-Git archive candidate scan.
findings.recommended_disposition: Include the handoff-referenced small plans, receipts, reviews, and authored helpers by explicit path allowlist; keep large raw Git command logs and unrelated historical artifacts separately dispositioned.

findings.logic: CODE_EXTS checks the final suffix, while is_snapshot_name only accepts specific marker words and endings; .py.original, .py.damaged.bak, .py.baseline_*, and arbitrary .py.disabled snapshots do not match that allowlist. Some files ending in .py remain included, but the coverage depends on their final suffix.
findings.effect: Authored source history/snapshot files can silently disappear. The path family for audit.py.baseline_139a5d5.py is under relicweave-synlab/tmp/review_20261003/pgfrag/pending_audit_patch/.
findings.recommended_disposition: Enumerate all files whose names contain a source suffix before another suffix; classify source snapshots separately from logs and generated outputs instead of using a short marker allowlist.

findings.logic: SELECTED_DATA_RELS stores paths prefixed with pgfrag/, but the per-repository os.walk compares repo-relative paths without that prefix.
findings.effect: These selected NPZ files cannot match the allowlist and fall through to generated numeric dataset exclusion.
findings.recommended_disposition: Normalize selection keys to the relevant repo-relative path or compare a structured repo/path pair. Reconfirm only the three root-approved replay artifacts; keep other mass artifacts excluded.

evidence.reason: is_generated_path checks output before the tests/fixtures inclusion branch
numeric fixture inclusion requires size <= 1 MiB

findings.logic: JSON generated-path exclusion precedes fixtures/tests inclusion; numeric fixtures larger than 1 MiB are excluded unless explicitly selected.
findings.effect: Required test fixtures can be silently dropped because of directory naming or an arbitrary size threshold.
findings.recommended_disposition: Prioritize recognized test/fixture fixture paths over generic output/report heuristics; list larger fixtures for explicit review rather than automatic exclusion.

findings.logic: The root-external walker does not prune third_party or call path_in_skipped_subtree; SKIP_SUBTREES is used only for repo walking and only for relicweave-synlab.
findings.effect: Source-like files inside root runtime/install bundles may be classified as project source. The Blender ZIP is ignored by current source extensions, but other source/config/license paths are traversed.
findings.recommended_disposition: Prune named runtime/install bundles at the external-root walk while separately retaining applicable project dependency manifests and legal notices.

findings.logic: CLOSED_REVIEW_ROOTS enumerates four specific PG roots. Outside those roots, JSON files need a directory segment such as tests/fixtures/schemas/configs/examples or a limited basename token; generic review/receipt/result JSON does not match.
findings.effect: Handoff-referenced small review JSON and receipts outside the four roots can be omitted even when Markdown siblings are included.
findings.recommended_disposition: Add a handoff-derived exact allowlist for all required small review JSON/receipts, including the VF final-source, 3mm/front, and PG front-independent artifacts; no path matching 3mm was found in this path scan.

findings.logic: The root-external walker includes ordinary .py files outside repository and backup-coordinator subtrees.
findings.effect: These four are visible candidates. The path tmp/_scratch_heads.py was not present; workspace-root _scratch_heads.py is present.
findings.recommended_disposition: Preserve the four current authored scripts with original relative-path/SHA mapping; verify the final manifest actually contains them.

evidence: No V1.46-named Markdown path was found by filename search; two V1.46 DOCX and two rendered PDFs were found.
findings.logic: Path-name search cannot identify a reference Markdown file whose name lacks V1.46; source content was not scanned.
findings.effect: The requested original V1.46 reference/MD needs a known path or an explicit final-manifest check.
findings.recommended_disposition: Root should bind the exact V1.46 Markdown source path in the final manifest; keep generated PDFs as references only if explicitly requested.
